title: about
subtitle: a little bit more about me :)
photosIntro: and the rest of the time:

strips.name: badminton
strips.title: badminton
strips.text: twice a week, most weeks, since school. the thing i've kept up longest that isn't work — showing up matters more than the score, and it's where i switch off.

strips.name: music
strips.title: music
strips.text: classical guitar since i was a kid. slow, repeated practice with no shortcut — the same patience i bring to a long debugging session.

photos.alt: Playing classical guitar on a sofa

strips.name: cat
strips.title: 崽崽 the cat
strips.text: zaizai runs the flat. she is the reason the desk stays tidy and the day has a routine — feed, work, play, repeat.

photos.alt: A grey-and-white cat lying between patterned cushions
A small living room with a grey sofa and a wooden bench
A tidy desk with a monitor, keyboard and a small clock

strips.name: photography
strips.title: photography
strips.text: a camera comes on every trip — west sichuan's mountains, hong kong at night. it taught me to wait, notice and frame before pressing anything, which is most of product work too.

photos.alt: A glacial valley under snow-capped peaks
In a beanie and face cover by a glacial lake, holding a spray can
Alone in a meadow below a snow mountain, arms out
A snow peak breaking through cloud
A waterfall through pine branches in the rain
Checking a shot on the camera with the Hong Kong skyline behind

map.title: where i've lived
map.lede: five cities i've actually lived in — not passed through.
map.text: born in inner mongolia, then home was beijing, chengdu and shanghai in turn; hong kong for university, and i never left. moving that often gave me a habit i'm grateful for: arrive curious, learn the local way of doing things, and find the people worth learning it from. hong kong is where i stopped counting cities. it is home now — and the place i want to keep building things for.
